minutes.headline: Zoom failed, so the Planning Board held an abbreviated meeting: two master plan appointees, a stormwater sign-off, a screening seat.
minutes.summary: The Zoom link did not work, so the board limited itself to time-sensitive items. It appointed two members at large to the master plan steering committee, continued the 255 Sun Hill Road hearing, approved a stormwater certificate of completion for 680 Reservoir Road, and named a member to the town manager screening committee. Reorganization was deferred, with the chair continued, and 321 Sun Hill Road was held back.
